notes: Without WITH DEBUGGING MODE a debugging line is a comment, and text a COPY statement introduces from a debugging line is itself on debugging lines (§1985:XII.2.4 GR9) (kb/Work PB5214, landed): CopyProcessor.ExpandCopiesOneLevel writes the library text behind the debugging-line carrier when the COPY begins on a carrier line, and the post-period remainder of that line keeps the carrier. Witnesses: pb5214-debugging-line-copy-no-mode (START, LIB-PLAIN, INIT, END) and pb5214-debugging-line-copy-mode (the copied text runs); nested COPY at 2002: pb5214-debugging-line-copy-nested-no-mode and -mode.

The 2023 SOURCE-COMPUTER format offers only computer-name-1, and no candidate mentions the WITH DEBUGGING MODE clause or debugging lines, so the clause and its default rule are dropped.
